violations.affected_code:
LongPressDraggable<String>(
  data: task,
  feedback: ...,
  child: Card(
    child: ListTile(title: Text(task)),
  ),
)
violations.explanation: Moving a task to 'Done' can only be done by long-pressing and dragging onto the DragTarget. No button, semantic custom action, or keyboard alternative exists. Screen reader users, switch/keyboard users, and users with motor impairments cannot complete the action (WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements, 2.1.1 Keyboard).

violations.type: Missing semantic action/hint for draggable item
violations.explanation: The draggable task cards expose only their text. Nothing in the semantics tree indicates that the item can be moved or marked done, such as a hint or a CustomSemanticsAction. Assistive technology users are not informed of the available functionality.
When a task moves from 'To do' to 'Done', no live region or SemanticsService announcement communicates the change. Screen reader users receive no feedback that the operation succeeded.
The drop zone has no semantic label or hint identifying it as a target for completing tasks. It also gives no accessible feedback while a drag is in progress, since the candidates are unused.
